👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Hello everybody,
Agar main aap se poochun ki Indian telecom industry ka sabse bada game-changing moment kab aaya hoga, to zyadaatar log 2016 hi kahenge—jab Jio ne apne saste data plans se poori industry ko hila kar rakh diya! Lekin, kya aap jaante ho ki isse lagbhag 20 saal pehle hi ek aur company ne Jio se bhi bada kamaal kar dikhaya tha? Gaon ho ya shehar, sabko sabse affordable calling plans dekar, unhone poore desh ko jod kar rakha tha!! Aur woh company thi… BSNL!
BSNL ki safalta ka aisa daur tha ki har dusre saal uske profits double hote ja rahe the. Sirf 5 saalon mein hi yeh 10,000 crore ka munafa kama chuki thi! Market share mein BSNL itna aage tha, ki aisa lag raha tha jaise telecom sector mein lambe samay tak sirf BSNL hi raaj karegi.
Lekin jis company ne 5 saalon mein 10,000 crore ka profit kamaaya tha, uski kismat poori tarah palat gayi! Aur palti toh palti ki aaj isse Indian telecpom industry ka sabse bada failure mana jaata hai!! Lekin aaj doston khushi ki bat ye hai ki BSNL finally 17 saalon ke baad profitable ban chuki hai!!!
Toh savaal ye hai ki BSNL achanak se 10,000 Cr ke profit se 15,000 cr ke loss me kaisi chali gayi?
Kya ye market ki taqat thi ya sarkar ka shhadyantra?
Aur 17 saal lagatar loss me hone ke baad, BSNL aaj profit kaise kamanelgi?
And BSNL ki kahaani se hum kya sikh skte hain janenge is episode me!!
